Good to know

Frequently asked questions

Useful answers about browser profiles, proxies, fingerprint settings, plans and supported workflows.

What is VertexStealth?

VertexStealth is an antidetect browser and multi-profile manager for Windows. It launches your installed Chrome or Firefox with a separate profile folder and individual browser settings, and includes proxy configuration, fingerprint controls, WebRTC options and inspection tools.

How does profile isolation work?

Each managed profile uses its own application-managed browser data folder. This keeps profile cookies and browser storage separate from other VertexStealth profiles and from your regular Chrome or Firefox profile.

Can I use my own proxy?

Yes. VertexStealth supports per-profile HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5 proxy configuration, including authenticated proxy workflows. Proxy performance and behavior depend on the provider, network, and configuration.

Which browsers and operating systems are supported?

VertexStealth is a Windows desktop app (Windows 10 and 11). It launches Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox, which must already be installed on your computer. macOS and Linux versions are not available yet.

Is VertexStealth free?

You can use VertexStealth for free with up to 3 browser profiles. New accounts also start with a 3-day trial without that limit. Paid plans cost $10 per month or $89 per year (USD) and remove the profile limit. Paid checkout is not open yet.

Do I need an account?

Yes. You create a VertexStealth account inside the app. The account holds your sign-in and plan details; your browser profiles, cookies and browsing data stay on your computer.

What is a browser fingerprint?

A browser fingerprint is a collection of browser and device signals that websites may use to distinguish sessions. Examples include browser version, platform, screen dimensions, language, timezone, fonts, and graphics-related properties.

Can VertexStealth guarantee anonymity or stop account bans?

No. Fingerprint configuration and profile separation do not guarantee anonymity, undetectability, or freedom from website restrictions. Sites can use many signals and their own policies. Use the software responsibly and follow applicable laws and platform terms.

Does VertexStealth include cloud profiles or team sharing?

No. Profiles are stored locally on your computer. VertexStealth does not host browser sessions in the cloud or share profiles between accounts. To enforce plan limits it keeps an opaque identifier for each profile with your account; see the Privacy Policy for details.
